title: Standard RFID Wood Card — FSC-Certified Body
summary: The Standard RFID Wood Card is an FSC-certified maple, bamboo, or beech card with a laminated RFID/NFC inlay and a 2–5 cm typical read range. It is the entry point for hospitality, membership, and luxury-branding programs that want a biodegradable card without giving up read range or chip choice. Available with NTAG 213/215/216, NTAG 424 DNA, MIFARE Classic 1k, MIFARE Plus EV2, MIFARE DESFire EV2/EV3, or ICODE SLIX inlays; MOQ is 500 pieces.
heroPoints: FSC-certified maple, bamboo, or beech wood body laminated with an RFID or NFC inlay.
Compatible with most NTAG, MIFARE, and ICODE chip families on request.
Read range 2–5 cm with NTAG 21x; up to 7 cm with MIFARE Plus EV2 on a quality reader.

brief.label: Specification
items: Material: FSC-certified maple, bamboo, or beech (custom species available).
Dimensions: standard CR80 (85.6 × 54 × 0.84 mm); custom thickness 0.6–1.2 mm.
Chip options: NTAG 213/215/216, NTAG 424 DNA, MIFARE Classic 1k, MIFARE Plus EV2, MIFARE DESFire EV2/EV3, ICODE SLIX, EM4100/4305.
Frequency: 13.56 MHz NFC/HF; 125 kHz LF on EM chips.
Memory: {chip:nxp-ntag-213:user_bytes} bytes (NTAG 213) up to {chip:nxp-ntag-216:user_bytes} bytes (NTAG 216), 8 KB (DESFire EV3).
Read range: 2–5 cm typical, up to 7 cm with high-power readers.

brief.label: Marking and finishing
items: Laser engraving (recommended for wood): logo, text, QR, sequential number.
Embossed numbering or hot-stamp foil on request.
Matte or gloss finish; food-safe lacquer for hospitality use.

brief.label: Sourcing
items: MOQ: 500 pieces per chip family and finish combination.
Sample turnaround: 7–10 working days (longer than plastic due to wood lamination cure).
Encoding (UID lock, NDEF, custom blocks) included in unit price.

brief.label: Best-fit applications
items: Hotel and resort key cards (premium and eco-positioning programs).
Membership and loyalty cards for luxury or sustainability brands.
Wedding and event invitations with embedded NFC review or RSVP links.
Discount or gift cards with biodegradable materials story.

sections.title: Why a wood card instead of PVC or PET
sections.intro: PVC remains the workhorse for RFID cards because it laminates cleanly, holds high-resolution print, and survives daily handling. Wood costs more, prints differently, and has a slightly shorter mechanical lifespan (18–24 months of typical hotel use versus 36–48 for PVC), but it earns its place when the program needs a sustainability or luxury story that PVC cannot tell.
bullets: Biodegradable: wood degrades naturally; PVC persists for decades.
FSC-certified supply: documented chain of custody for sustainability audits.
Distinct tactile feel: the 0.84 mm CR80 body is noticeably warmer and less plasticky than PVC.
Laser-friendly: deep, permanent engraving without ink lamination steps.
Reduced microplastic shedding: matters for premium hospitality and luxury branding.

sections.title: Where the wood card has limits
sections.intro: Wood is not always the right choice. Knowing where it underperforms is part of buying it well.
bullets: High-volume disposable use (one-time event passes): cost per piece is too high relative to PVC or paper.
Wet environments: humidity and water can warp or stain the wood. Use only with sealed lacquer.
Detailed full-color print: wood grain shows through; smooth edge-to-edge color requires UV printing or veneer overlays.
Industrial laundry: wood does not survive autoclave cycles. Use PPS or silicone tags instead.

sections.title: How we test before shipping
sections.intro: Every encoded wood card goes through the same QC pass as our PVC cards, plus a wood-specific dimensional check.
bullets: 100% functional read test on every encoded card.
Dimensional check: thickness ±0.05 mm, flatness within 0.2 mm.
Lamination cure test: 24-hour rest before engraving or shipping.
Engraving QC: visual check on laser depth, contrast, registration.
Pack-out: individual sleeve or branded box on request.

faq.question: Can the wood card be used in hotel locks?
faq.answer: Yes, with the right chip family. MIFARE Plus EV2 and MIFARE DESFire EV3 wood cards work with Saflok, VingCard, Onity, Salto, and Häfele Dialock locks. Confirm the lock model and firmware version when ordering so we match the chip-family expectation.

faq.question: How long does the wood card last in daily hospitality use?
faq.answer: Expect 18–24 months of typical hotel-room use before mechanical wear becomes visible. Lamination is sealed and the chip is unaffected, but the wood surface eventually shows scratching from key chains and pockets. PVC lasts 36–48 months in the same use.

faq.question: Can I get a custom wood species?
faq.answer: Maple, bamboo, and beech are stocked. Walnut, cherry, and oak are available on request with longer lead times and a small species premium. We will share dimensional samples before committing to a production run.

faq.question: Is the wood card recyclable?
faq.answer: The wood body is biodegradable. The chip and antenna are recyclable through standard e-waste channels. We do not yet offer a take-back program; if your sustainability audit needs end-of-life documentation, we can supply the chip and antenna BOM for downstream processing.
